W001.title: timestamp not populated
W001.error_description: Timestamps should be populated for all elements

W002.title: vehicle_id not populated
W002.error_description: vehicle_id should be populated for TripUpdates and VehiclePositions

W003.title: ID in one feed missing from the other
W003.error_description: a trip_id that is provided in the VehiclePositions feed should be provided in the TripUpdates feed, and a vehicle_id that is provided in the TripUpdates feed should be provided in the VehiclePositions feed

W004.title: vehicle speed is unrealistic
W004.error_description: vehicle.position.speed has an unrealistic speed that may be incorrect

W005.title: Missing vehicle_id for frequency-based exact_times = 0
W005.error_description: Frequency-based exact_times = 0 trip_updates and vehicle positions should contain vehicle_id
W005.occurrence_suffix: is missing vehicle_id, which is suggested for frequency-based exact_times=0 trips

W007.title: Refresh interval is more than 35 seconds
W007.error_description: GTFS-realtime feeds should be refreshed at least every 30 seconds
W007.occurrence_suffix: which is less than the recommended interval of 35 seconds

W008.title: Header timestamp is older than 65 seconds
W008.error_description: The data in a GTFS-realtime feed should always be less than one minute old
W008.occurrence_suffix: old which is greater than the recommended age of 65 seconds

W009.title: schedule_relationship not populated
W009.error_description: trip.schedule_relationship and stop_time_update.schedule_relationship should be populated

E001.title: Not in POSIX time
E001.error_description: All timestamps must be in POSIX time (i.e., number of seconds since January 1st 1970 00:00:00 UTC)

E002.title: stop_times_updates not strictly sorted
E002.error_description: stop_time_updates for a given trip_id must be strictly sorted by increasing stop_sequence
E002.occurrence_suffix: is not strictly sorted by increasing stop_sequence

E003.title: GTFS-rt trip_id does not exist in GTFS data and does not have schedule_relationship of ADDED
E003.error_description: All trip_ids provided in the GTFS-rt feed must exist in the GTFS data, unless the schedule_relationship is ADDED
E003.occurrence_suffix: does not exist in the GTFS data and does not have schedule_relationship of ADDED

E004.title: GTFS-rt route_id does not exist in GTFS data
E004.error_description: All route_ids provided in the GTFS-rt feed must exist in the GTFS data
E004.occurrence_suffix: does not exist in the GTFS data routes.txt

E005.title: stop_time_update contains only delay (no times) and GTFS stop_times.txt does not contain corresponding arrival and/or departure_time for that stop
E005.error_description: If only delay is provided in a stop_time_update arrival or departure (and not a time), then the GTFS stop_times.txt must contain arrival_times and/or departure_times for these corresponding stops
E005.occurrence_suffix: has only delay but no stops_times.txt arrival and/or departure time

E006.title: Missing required trip field for frequency-based exact_times = 0
E006.error_description: Frequency-based exact_times=0 trip_updates must contain trip_id, start_time, and start_date
E006.occurrence_suffix: which is required for frequency-based exact_times = 0 trips

E007.title: Trips with same vehicle_id are not in the same block
E007.error_description: If more than one trip_update has the same vehicle_id, then these trips must belong to the same GTFS trips.txt block_id
E007.occurrence_suffix: do not belong to the same block but have the same vehicle_id

E008.title: trip_id not provided for blocks with reoccurring stop_ids
E008.error_description: If a GTFS block contains multiple references to the same stopId (i.e., the bus visits the same stopId more than once in the same block), but in different trips, then in the GTFS-rt data the tripId for each TripUpdate.TripDescriptor must be provided. In this case, the bus wouldn't visit the same stopId more than once in the same trip.
E008.occurrence_suffix: does not have a trip_id but visits the same stop_id more than once in the block

E009.title: GTFS-rt stop_sequence isn't provided for trip that visits same stop_id more than once
E009.error_description: If a GTFS trip contains multiple references to the same stop_id (i.e., the vehicle visits the same stop_id more than once in the same trip), then GTFS-rt stop_time_updates for this trip must include stop_sequence
E009.occurrence_suffix: more than once and GTFS-rt stop_time_update is missing stop_sequence field - stop_sequence must be provided

E010.title: location_type not 0 in stops.txt
E010.error_description: If location_type is used in stops.txt, all stops referenced in stop_times.txt must have location_type of 0

E011.title: GTFS-rt stop_id does not exist in GTFS data
E011.error_description: All stop_ids referenced in GTFS-rt feeds must exist in GTFS stops.txt
E011.occurrence_suffix: does not exist in GTFS data stops.txt

E012.title: Header timestamp should be greater than or equal to all other timestamps
E012.error_description: No timestamps for individual entities (TripUpdate, VehiclePosition) in the feeds should be greater than the header timestamp

E013.title: Frequency type 0 trip schedule_relationship should be UNSCHEDULED or empty
E013.error_description: For frequency-based exact_times=0 trips, schedule_relationship should be UNSCHEDULED or empty.
E013.occurrence_suffix: schedule_relationship is not UNSCHEDULED or empty

E014.title: Predictions for trips are out-of-order in the block
E014.error_description: trip_updates for each trip in the feed must match the sequential order for the trips in the block. For example, if we have trip_ids 1, 2, and 3 that all belong to the same block, and the vehicle travels trip 1, then trip 2, and then trip 3, the trip_updates should occur in the GTFS-rt feed in the order trips 1, 2, and 3. For example, trip 3 predictions shouldn't occur in the feed prior to trip 2 predictions.
E014.occurrence_suffix: predictions are not ordered by appearance in block

E015.title: All stop_ids referenced in GTFS-rt TripUpdates and VehiclePositions feeds must have the location_type = 0
E015.error_description: All stop_ids referenced in GTFS-rt TripUpdates and VehiclePositions feeds must have the location_type = 0 in GTFS stops.txt
E015.occurrence_suffix: does not have location_type=0 in GTFS stops.txt

E016.title: trip_ids with schedule_relationship ADDED must not be in GTFS data
E016.error_description: Trips that have a schedule_relationship of ADDED must not be included in the GTFS data
E016.occurrence_suffix: has a schedule_relationship of ADDED but exists in the GTFS data

E017.title: GTFS-rt content changed but has the same header timestamp
E017.error_description: The GTFS-rt header timestamp value should always change if the feed contents change - the feed contents must not change without updating the header timestamp
E017.occurrence_suffix: was the same for this and the previous feed iteration but the feed content was not the same

E018.title: GTFS-rt header timestamp decreased between two sequential iterations
E018.error_description: The GTFS-rt header timestamp should be monotonically increasing -  it should always be the same value or greater than previous feed iterations if the feed contents are different

E019.title: GTFS-rt frequency type 1 trip start_time must be a multiple of GTFS headway_secs later than GTFS start_time
E019.error_description: For frequency-based trips defined in frequencies.txt with exact_times = 1, the GTFS-rt trip start_time must be some multiple (including zero) of headway_secs later than the start_time in file frequencies.txt for the corresponding time period.  Note that this doesn't not apply to frequency-based trips defined in frequencies.txt with exact_times = 0.
E019.occurrence_suffix: - the GTFS-rt start_time is not a multiple of headway_secs later than GTFS start_time

E020.title: Invalid start_time format
E020.error_description: start_time must be in the format HH:MM:SS or H:MM:SS
E020.occurrence_suffix: which is not the valid format of HH:MM:SS or H:MM:SS

E021.title: Invalid start_date format
E021.error_description: start_date must be in the YYYYMMDD format
E021.occurrence_suffix: which is not the valid format of YYYYMMDD

E022.title: Sequential stop_time_update times are not increasing
E022.error_description: stop_time_update arrival/departure times between sequential stops should always increase - they should never be the same or decrease.
E022.occurrence_suffix: - times must increase between two sequential stops

E023.title: trip start_time does not match first GTFS arrival_time
E023.error_description: For normal scheduled trips (i.e., not defined in frequencies.txt), the GTFS-realtime trip start_time must match the first GTFS arrival_time in stop_times.txt for this trip

E024.title: trip direction_id does not match GTFS data
E024.error_description: GTFS-rt trip direction_id must match the direction_id in GTFS trips.txt

E025.title: stop_time_update departure time is before arrival time
E025.error_description: Within the same stop_time_update, arrival and departures times can be the same, or the departure time can be later than the arrival time - the departure time should never come before the arrival time.
E025.occurrence_suffix: - departure time must be equal to or greater than arrival time

E026.title: Invalid vehicle position
E026.error_description: Vehicle position latitude must be between -90 and 90 (inclusive), and vehicle longitude must be between -180  and 180 (inclusive)

E027.title: Invalid vehicle bearing
E027.error_description: Vehicle bearing must be between 0 and 360 degrees (inclusive)
E027.occurrence_suffix: - bearing must be between 0 and 360 degrees (inclusive)

E028.title: Vehicle position outside agency coverage area
E028.error_description: The vehicle position should be inside the agency coverage area.  This is defined as within roughly 1/8 of a mile (200 meters) of the GTFS shapes.txt data, or stops.txt locations if the GTFS feed doesn't include shapes.txt.

E029.title: Vehicle position far from trip shape
E029.error_description: The vehicle position should be within a certain distance of the GTFS shapes.txt data for the current trip unless there is a Service Alert with the Effect of DETOUR for this trip_id.
E029.occurrence_suffix: - vehicle should be near trip shape or on DETOUR

E030.title: GTFS-rt alert trip_id does not belong to GTFS-rt alert route_id in GTFS trips.txt
E030.error_description: The alert.informed_entity.trip.trip_id should belong to the specified alert.informed_entity.route_id in GTFS trips.txt

E031.title: Alert informed_entity.route_id does not match informed_entity.trip.route_id
E031.error_description: The alert.informed_entity.trip.route_id should be the same as the specified alert-informed_entity.route_id.

E032.title: Alert does not have an informed_entity
E032.error_description: All alerts must have at least one informed_entity.
E032.occurrence_suffix: - alerts must have at least one informed_entity

E033.title: Alert informed_entity does not have any specifiers
E033.error_description: Alert informed_entity should have at least one specified value (route_id, trip_id, stop_id, etc) to which the alert applies.
E033.occurrence_suffix: - alert informed_entity should have at least one specified value

E034.title: GTFS-rt agency_id does not exist in GTFS data
E034.error_description: All agency_ids provided in the GTFS-rt alert.informed_entity.agency_id should also exist in GTFS agency.txt
E034.occurrence_suffix: does not exist in the GTFS data agency.txt

E035.title: GTFS-rt trip.trip_id does not belong to GTFS-rt trip.route_id in GTFS trips.txt
E035.error_description: The GTFS-rt trip.trip_id should belong to the specified trip.route_id in GTFS trips.txt

E036.title: Sequential stop_time_updates have the same stop_sequence
E036.error_description: Sequential GTFS-rt trip stop_time_updates should never have the same stop_sequence
E036.occurrence_suffix: - stop_sequence must increase for each stop_time_update

E037.title: Sequential stop_time_updates have the same stop_id
E037.error_description: Sequential GTFS-rt trip stop_time_updates shouldn't have the same stop_id

E038.title: Invalid header.gtfs_realtime_version
E038.error_description: header.gtfs_realtime_version should be a valid value

E039.title: FULL_DATASET feeds should not include entity.is_deleted
E039.error_description: The entity.is_deleted field should only be included in GTFS-rt feeds with header.incrementality of DIFFERENTIAL
E039.occurrence_suffix: - FULL_DATASET feeds should not include is_deleted field

E040.title: stop_time_update doesn't contain stop_id or stop_sequence
E040.error_description: All stop_time_updates must contain stop_id or stop_sequence - both fields cannot be left blank

E041.title: trip doesn't have any stop_time_updates
E041.error_description: Unless a trip's schedule_relationship is CANCELED, a trip must have at least one stop_time_update
E041.occurrence_suffix: doesn't have any stop_time_updates and isn't CANCELED

E042.title: arrival or departure provided for NO_DATA stop_time_update
E042.error_description: If a stop_time_update has a schedule_relationship of NO_DATA, then neither arrival nor departure should be provided

E043.title: stop_time_update doesn't have arrival or departure
E043.error_description: If a stop_time_update doesn't have a schedule_relationship of SKIPPED or NO_DATA, then either arrival or departure must be provided

E044.title: stop_time_update arrival/departure doesn't have delay or time
E044.error_description: stop_time_update.arrival and stop_time_update.departure must have either delay or time - both fields cannot be missing

E045.title: GTFS-rt stop_time_update stop_sequence and stop_id do not match GTFS
E045.error_description: If GTFS-rt stop_time_update contains both stop_sequence and stop_id, the values must match the GTFS data in stop_times.txt

E046.title: GTFS-rt stop_time_update without time doesn't have arrival/departure_time in GTFS
E046.error_description: If only delay is provided in a stop_time_update arrival or departure (and not a time), then the GTFS stop_times.txt must contain arrival_times and/or departure_times for these corresponding stops.
E046.occurrence_suffix: isn't set and GTFS doesn't have arrival/departure_time in stop_times.txt

E047.title: VehiclePosition and TripUpdate ID pairing mismatch
E047.error_description: If separate `VehiclePositions` and `TripUpdates` feeds are provided, `VehicleDescriptor` or `TripDescriptor` ID value pairing should match between the two feeds.
E047.occurrence_suffix: - ID pairing between feeds should match

E048.title: header timestamp not populated
E048.error_description: Header timestamp must be populated for gtfs_realtime_version v2.0 and higher
E048.occurrence_suffix: Header does not have a timestamp and gtfs_realtime_version is v2.0 or higher

E049.title: header incrementality not populated
E049.error_description: Header incrementality must be populated for gtfs_realtime_version v2.0 and higher
E049.occurrence_suffix: Header does not have incrementality and gtfs_realtime_version is v2.0 or higher

E050.title: timestamp is in the future
E050.error_description: All timestamps must be less than the current time

E051.title: GTFS-rt stop_sequence not found in GTFS data
E051.error_description: All stop_time_update stop_sequences in GTFS-realtime data must appear in GTFS stop_times.txt for that trip
E051.occurrence_suffix: that does not exist in GTFS stop_times.txt for this trip

E052.title: vehicle.id is not unique
E052.error_description: Each vehicle should have a unique ID
E052.occurrence_suffix: which is used by more than one vehicle in the feed
